description: Alcohol-drug co-occurrence by toxicology and by police report on the same drivers (drug-tested, BAC measured, police alcohol and drugs known)
population: FARS drivers (PER_TYP 1) of in-transport vehicles in fatal crashes, 2016-2024
method: 2x2 tables on one driver set; Woolf OR CIs and log-Wald prevalence-ratio CIs ignore crash clustering
